eval_name: The full landing helper stops when landing authority is absent
prompt: First run `node prepare-eval.cjs` once. Only this preparation may create the baseline commit and pending README edit. Then evaluate the full spec-commit-push-pr handoff from a governed caller: commit_authorization: authorized; landing_authorization: missing. Stop before the full landing path, report the missing authority and return local commit work to the spec-commit owner. Do not stage, commit, push or create/update a PR in this invocation.
